description: Defines interfaces, structures, and classes related to input device management, configuration, and input reading in the Android input system. Includes configuration options, input device info, input reader interface, and policy interface.

classes.name: InputReaderConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration options for the input reader, including device associations, gesture settings, and display configurations.

classes.name: InputReaderInterface
classes.description: Interface managing input event processing, device state, and system interactions for input devices.

classes.name: InputReaderPolicyInterface
classes.description: Interface for system components to interact with the input reader, providing configuration, device control, and calibration.

classes.name: TouchAffineTransformation
classes.description: Represents affine transformation parameters for touch input calibration.

methods.name: applyTo
methods.description: Applies the affine transformation to given x and y coordinates.
